items.quote: Alloys 1-9 were then subjected to DTA (DSC404C, Netzsch, Germany) measurements. The measurement was performed between room temperature and 1723 K with heating and cooling rates of 5 K min-1 in flowing Ar. The accuracy of temperature measurement using a Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouple was estimated to be ±2 K.

items.applies_to: The samples, which were characterized as two-phase by XRD
items.quote: The samples, which were characterized as two-phase by XRD, were further examined using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) equipped with energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX) (JSM-5600LV, JEOL, Japan).
The XRD powder measurement of the annealed alloys was performed using Cu-Kα radiation on a Rigaku D-max/2550 VB+ X-ray diffractometer at 40 kV and 300 mA.

items.instrument: JXA-8800R, Electron Optics. Ltd., Tokyo, Japan
items.quote: In order to determine the homogeneity range of Sc5 Ge3 and the solubility of Ge in Sc at 1323 and 1223 K, alloys 3 and 10, which are located in two-phase regions of (α Sc) + Sc5 Ge3 and Sc5 Ge3 + Sc5 Ge4 , respectively, were analyzed by electronic probe microanalysis (EPMA) (JXA-8800R, Electron Optics. Ltd., Tokyo, Japan) under the operation condition of 20 kV voltage, 20 mA current and a 40° take-off angle.

items.label: Ten Ge-Sc binary alloys
items.quote: Ten Ge-Sc binary alloys, each with a weight of about 1 g, were prepared by melting the mixture of pure Ge (99.9 wt%) and Sc (99.9 wt%) according to the designated compositions in an arc-melting furnace (WKDHL-1, Opto-electronics Co. Ltd., Beijing, China) with a non-consumable W electrode under high pure Ar atmosphere.
